Room.title: Room
Room.description: Real-time multiplayer party game room holding turn state, question pool tracking, and configuration.

hostId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the current room host.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the room.

gameNumber.description: Monotonically incremented session counter for Play Again resets.

gameMode.description: Game length mode: rounds (capped at 63 total questions) or all_questions (all 63 questions).

roundsCount.description: Configured number of full rounds (1 to 31, capped so players x rounds <= 63).

randomFirstPlayer.description: Whether the first player order is randomized on game start.

soundEnabled.description: Default sound effects state for the room.

playerOrder.description: Ordered list of player UIDs participating in the room (max 12).

playerCount.description: Number of active players in the room (0 to 12).

currentTurnIndex.description: Zero-based index into playerOrder for the current active turn.

totalTurnsCompleted.description: Total turns taken (completed + skipped) in the current game.

completedQuestionsCount.description: Number of questions answered normally via Next Question.

skippedQuestionsCount.description: Number of questions skipped in the current multiplayer game.

currentQuestionId.description: Active official question ID (1 to 63), or null when not playing.

usedQuestionIds.description: List of official question IDs already drawn in the current game (max 63).

activePlayerId.description: UID of the player whose turn it currently is, or null.

turnNonce.description: Monotonic counter incremented on every turn transition to block race conditions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last room mutation.

RoomPlayer.title: RoomPlayer
RoomPlayer.description: Player membership document inside a multiplayer room with independent 3-skip quota.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

avatarColor.description: Gradient palette key for the player avatar.

isHost.description: Whether this player is currently the room host.

skipsRemaining.description: Remaining skips for this player in the current game (0 to 3).

skipsUsed.description: Skips consumed by this player in the current game (0 to 3).

joinedAt.description: Server timestamp when the player joined.

lastSeenAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest presence heartbeat.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Top-level multiplayer game room documents keyed by 6-character roomCode.

/rooms/{roomId}/players/{playerId}.description: Per-player membership state and independent 3-skip counters inside a room.
